strings.jp: ピイ！　ピイ{h }ピイ‥‥
strings.en: Cheep! Cheep cheep...

strings.jp:
‥‥？
なんの{h }なきごえだろ‥‥？
strings.en:
...?
What's making that sound...?

strings.jp:
（ガサガサ）
えっと　ここらへんから{h }こえが‥‥
strings.en:
(Rustle rustle)
Um, the voice came from around here...

strings.jp:
‥‥こんなところに
とりのヒナがいる！
strings.en:
...There's a baby bird
in a place like this!

strings.jp:
この木の上の{h }とりのす
からおちたんだ！
strings.en:
It fell from the bird's nest
up in this tree!

strings.jp: もとに{h }もどしてあげなきゃ！
strings.en: I have to put it back!

strings.jp:
とりのすから{h }おちてた
ヒナを{h }たすけてあげたよ
strings.en:
You rescued a baby bird
that fell from its nest!
